## Acceptance ledger
- [ ] Every requested behavior/constraint is listed and addressed
- [ ] Previously validated decisions are preserved

## Architecture
- [ ] Applicable contracts were read
- [ ] Canonical source/engine/component and consumers were identified
- [ ] No duplicate mechanism/source of truth was introduced
- [ ] Replaced obsolete layers were removed where safe

## Verification
- [ ] Relevant automated checks were run
- [ ] Related navigation/permissions/data flows were regression-checked
- [ ] Mobile/responsive/visual behavior was checked when applicable
- [ ] Auth/RLS/security implications were reviewed when applicable
- [ ] Cache/loader/service-worker versions are coherent when applicable

## Evidence
Describe the checks actually executed and their results.

## Blocked / unverified
List anything that could not be verified. Do not leave this section implicit.
